blocks.caption: The location of the first portal

blocks.html: Go to the Varrock Dig Site and step on the strange portal near the entrance to the Empty Throne Room. It is found north of the screening station.
blocks.text: Go to the Varrock Dig Site and step on the strange portal near the entrance to the Empty Throne Room. It is found north of the screening station.
Key rules

blocks.html: Leaving (teleport, logging out, etc) fully resets the puzzle and hints.

blocks.caption: Example of a word grid to solve sliding puzzle after unlocking all the chests

blocks.html: Step on the portals until a room with a chest unlocks.
blocks.text: Step on the portals until a room with a chest unlocks.

substeps.html: If the room has a note on a recipe: If the amount of each & every ingredient can be represented with a single Roman numeral (e.g. 1000g of Bacon = "M"), those are the code. If not, the code is the first letter of each ingredient.
substeps.text: If the room has a note on a recipe: If the amount of each & every ingredient can be represented with a single Roman numeral (e.g. 1000g of Bacon = "M"), those are the code. If not, the code is the first letter of each ingredient.

substeps.html: Note: Roman numerals for some of the steps below: 1=I, 5=V, 10=X, 50=L, 100=C, 500=D, 1,000=M.
substeps.text: Note: Roman numerals for some of the steps below: 1=I, 5=V, 10=X, 50=L, 100=C, 500=D, 1,000=M.

substeps.html: If the room has 4 random items, the code for the chest is the first letter of each item (e.g. Plank, Jute Fibres, Catfish and Diamond Bolt). Order is starting from farthest item from the chest to the closest item to the chest. If this doesn't work, try the letters in the opposite order. Due to recent changes Longbows are S instead of L.
substeps.text: If the room has 4 random items, the code for the chest is the first letter of each item (e.g. Plank, Jute Fibres, Catfish and Diamond Bolt). Order is starting from farthest item from the chest to the closest item to the chest. If this doesn't work, try the letters in the opposite order. Due to recent changes Longbows are S instead of L.

substeps.html: If the room has coins on the ground examine each pile, the code is the number of coins in each pile. Go clockwise, as represented in Roman numerals (e.g. 500 coins = "D").
substeps.text: If the room has coins on the ground examine each pile, the code is the number of coins in each pile. Go clockwise, as represented in Roman numerals (e.g. 500 coins = "D").

substeps.html: If there is a plaque next to the room's door, the code is the first letter of each lodestone name depicted (e.g. Lumbridge, Falador, Draynor Village and Varrock).
substeps.text: If there is a plaque next to the room's door, the code is the first letter of each lodestone name depicted (e.g. Lumbridge, Falador, Draynor Village and Varrock).

substeps.html: If the room has only one item on the ground with a four-letter word in its name, the combination is those four letters. (e.g. Beer = BEER or Swordfish = FISH).
substeps.text: If the room has only one item on the ground with a four-letter word in its name, the combination is those four letters. (e.g. Beer = BEER or Swordfish = FISH).

substeps.html: If the room has a clean herb on the ground, the combination is HERB.
substeps.text: If the room has a clean herb on the ground, the combination is HERB.

blocks.html: When the chest is unlocked, note the order of the icons.
blocks.text: When the chest is unlocked, note the order of the icons.

blocks.html: Repeat for as many chests as needed until you have the full solution.
blocks.text: Repeat for as many chests as needed until you have the full solution.

blocks.html: Rearrange the slide puzzle in the middle to match the icons seen from the chests.
blocks.text: Rearrange the slide puzzle in the middle to match the icons seen from the chests.

substeps.html: North side is up. If you accidentally did the puzzle upside down, just rotate the outer pieces until they are in place.
substeps.text: North side is up. If you accidentally did the puzzle upside down, just rotate the outer pieces until they are in place.

substeps.html: The puzzle is solved just as one would solve a Treasure Trails puzzle box or Dungeoneering sliding tile puzzle. If done successfully, the room will shake and you will obtain a key, which will automatically combine with the necklace as you receive it, and a magic portal leading outside will appear.
substeps.text: The puzzle is solved just as one would solve a Treasure Trails puzzle box or Dungeoneering sliding tile puzzle. If done successfully, the room will shake and you will obtain a key, which will automatically combine with the necklace as you receive it, and a magic portal leading outside will appear.

substeps.html: If you need help solving this puzzle, try using a "sliding puzzle solver" found online.
substeps.text: If you need help solving this puzzle, try using a "sliding puzzle solver" found online.
